metric_definitions.rmsd_definition: Double precision terminal injective Hungarian of nine original PLIP points in protein-registered frame; no ligand fit.
metric_definitions.affinity_definition: Saved terminal affinity.pic50 only; all predicted rows including failed builds; no forward/rescore.
metric_definitions.SA_definition: Standard RDKit SA on successfully built SMILES only; not 3D conformation quality.
metric_definitions.outlier_policy: At least10 finite, at most10% excluded; RMSD upper Q3+max(3IQR,1A); pIC50/SA outer3IQR; missing/nonfinite not outliers.
metric_definitions.top10_policy: Best ceil(10% of finite observations), each metric selected independently; pIC50 descending, RMSD/SA ascending.

bootstrap_definition: All 3125 ordered five-seed cluster resamples, preserving each seed's paired rows; percentile 95% descriptive interval, adaptive fixed panel, not independent inference.
